entries.title: Check for updates whenever you like
entries.body: Settings → General now has a Check for updates button beside Version, on every copy, including Homebrew and Linux. It looks for a new release right away, instead of waiting for the next quiet check, and says what it found: that you have the latest release, that a newer version is available, or that updates could not be checked. When a version is available, Show update opens the update notice, where installing still waits for your click. Check for updates is also in command search.

picture.alt: The Version row in Settings with Check for updates and the line Version 0.1.31 is available, beside Show update
